title: Rim-lit tilted page section tour
summary: Four sections of a dark storefront page glide past on a tilted plane lit by bright edge bars, one hard cut each, then a gold mark card, a plain wordmark and the whole page shrunk into a phone. Only the camera moves.
use_when: A premium or luxury storefront or landing page with a dark theme and a metal-coloured accent
Silent autoplay showcase of an existing website, section by section
The page already looks good and only needs a camera, not new animation
Closing on the logo plus a mobile view of the same page

look.type_style: headlines geometric grotesk, semibold, sentence case with periods, tight, ~6 % H on the plane; body light italic-feel grotesk ~2.5 % H in grey; button labels wide-tracked caps; gold tracked caps label; final wordmark small semibold grotesk ~2.5 % H

sfx.event: hard cut to the next tilted section
phone with the full page appears

structure.shot: hero section of a dark store page on a tilted plane: 2-line headline, 2-line sub, pale pill button; white rim bars at both edges
structure.camera: tilt-plane, push-in 1.00->1.04 over 93 fr (1.2-1.45 %/s), drift up 2-5 px/s @1920, easings.linear
structure.motion: none: every element is on from frame 0; only the camera moves

structure.shot: image slide of the page: clothing-rack photo, 3-word statement in two lines, two slider dots (active one in gold); plane tilted ~10 deg
structure.camera: tilt-plane + dolly: content rises 63 px/s @1920 (2.1 px/fr), push-in 1.00->1.09 over 98 fr (2.4-4.4 %/s), easings.linear
structure.motion: none: slide and copy are on at the cut frame f93; no entrance

structure.shot: follow-us block at the right: 2-line headline, 2-line sub, gold pill button cropped by the frame; one diagonal white rim bar at the left; far edge out of focus
structure.camera: tilt-plane with depth of field + dolly: content travels left 63-73 px/s @1920 (2.3 px/fr), scale +0.2-0.9 %/s, easings.linear
structure.motion: none: block on at the cut frame f191; only the camera moves

structure.shot: contact column top-left: gold tracked caps label, 2 channel names, 3 phone lines, on a near-black plane; diagonal rim bar across the corner
structure.camera: tilt-plane + dolly: content travels right 78-81 px/s @1920 (2.7 px/fr), push 1.00->1.04 over 124 fr, roll -0.5 to -0.8 deg/s, easings.linear
structure.motion: none: column on at f301 (cut measured on a 30 fps strip); only the camera moves

structure.shot: black card ~57 % W x 89 % H centred on near-black, gold monogram in an open ring above a tracked serif wordmark and a small ruled sub-line
structure.motion: none: card on at f425 in one frame (30 fps strip); holds 75 fr

structure.shot: brand name as plain small white semibold text, 2 words, centred on flat near-black
structure.motion: text on at f500; the card behind fades out over ~3 fr after the cut (30 fps strip); holds 90 fr

params.brand: any dark brand.json: bg near-black, fg off-white, accent a metal tone (gold) for the label, active dot and one button
params.content.hero: headline (2 lines, <= 4 words, periods), sub (<= 14 words), button label (2 words)
params.content.slide: photo src + statement of 3 words over two lines
params.content.follow: headline (2 lines), sub (<= 10 words), button label
params.content.contacts: caps label + 2 channel names + up to 3 contact lines
params.content.mark: logo image for the card row
params.content.name: brand name for the plain wordmark row
params.content.mobileShot: full-height mobile screenshot of the page (or the rebuilt page at phone width)
params.timing.sections: section lengths at 30 fps: 93, 98, 110, 124 fr; logo 75, wordmark 90, phone 149

notes: No element animates: every section, the logo card, the wordmark and the phone enter by a hard cut and only the camera moves (linear drift 2-3 px/fr at 1920, scale 1-4 %/s). Each tilted section moves in a new direction (up, left, right) so cuts read as a tour. Rim light bars along the plane edges are the main look; not in the vocabulary (Proposed terms: rim-light-bar). Cuts at 10.03, 14.17, 16.67, 19.67 were missed by the detector (dark low-contrast scenes) and measured on 30 fps strips. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
